needleClasses: K internal keys outside general R1 claim
discoveryRule: Enumerate unknown surfaces; this source inventory is not a collection allowlist.

surfaces.surface: IndexedDB content databases: every discovered store/key/record
surfaces.expected: Ciphertext and public format/routing/counter fields; W/F forbidden, including schema and keys.
surfaces.requiredControl: Unknown database/store/key plus strings, typed views and Blob leaks.
surfaces.limit: The slot index and derived-name prefixes cannot bound discovery.

surfaces.surface: IndexedDB done.custody/entries: seals and credentials
surfaces.expected: Sealed roots/credentials with public metadata. No known factor spelling.
surfaces.requiredControl: Plant W/F in an unexpected nested property and binary view.
surfaces.limit: A valid MAC is not confidentiality; opaque CryptoKey contents remain outside R1.

surfaces.surface: IndexedDB custody Local claim, import, clear and promotion progress
surfaces.expected: IDs/digests/stages/authenticators; entire raw clone scanned before parsing.
surfaces.requiredControl: Unexpected source-name or manifest field contains W.
surfaces.limit: R1 fresh promotion exercises only present records; migration/clear paths remain later trials.

surfaces.surface: IndexedDB done.slots/slots
surfaces.expected: Local/Account routing and public bindings.
surfaces.requiredControl: W in unexpected slot property/key.
surfaces.limit: Source comments about the old default app do not establish current reachability.

surfaces.surface: IndexedDB done.account-recovery-preparation.v1/progress/pending
surfaces.expected: Sealed recovery draft; report sensitive retryKey and finalization.retryKey. Recovery code/private keys are not retained fields.
surfaces.requiredControl: F leak in generate/finalization-pending/confirmed states through real browser recovery owner.
surfaces.limit: Native ready() bypasses this owner. Confirmation does not erase progress; known retry capabilities are not public metadata.

surfaces.surface: localStorage current encrypted journal
surfaces.expected: v2 header plus base64 generation/nonce/ciphertext; W/F forbidden.
surfaces.requiredControl: Actual pre-return write-path side record containing plaintext update; find W with complete native write.
surfaces.limit: Do not flush the held journal-only point before collection; prefix-based parsing is not collection authority.

surfaces.surface: localStorage legacy actor/device/relay metadata and v1 journal
surfaces.expected: Absent in fresh histories. Current device-label W may not appear in done.device.
surfaces.requiredControl: Unknown localStorage key/value contains W/F; a v1 raw update is detectable.
surfaces.limit: Intentional pre-cleanup legacy exposure needs a separate trial; not a blanket metadata exception.

surfaces.surface: Current user-content producers and volatile broadcast channels
surfaces.expected: W enters current master/card/actor/device-label owners; live plaintext is expected.
surfaces.requiredControl: Assert live and cold recovered W; an absent input cannot qualify a negative scan.
surfaces.limit: BroadcastChannel is volatile, not persistent; no memory or live-origin confidentiality claim.

surfaces.surface: CacheStorage caches, request/response headers and bodies
surfaces.expected: Static asset cache in packaged app; no W/F. First native run may have no installed generated worker.
surfaces.requiredControl: Unknown cache with W/F in request metadata and response body.
surfaces.limit: Empty native collection plus plants qualifies collector only; real packaged flow deferred. HTTP disk cache is separate.

surfaces.surface: sessionStorage in each live page
surfaces.expected: No writer source hit in recorded query; enumerate all available keys/values.
surfaces.requiredControl: Leak in original page before close, plus unknown keys.
surfaces.limit: New-page emptiness cannot describe a closed page; missing access is incomplete.

surfaces.surface: Cookies across disposable browser context, including HTTP-only
surfaces.expected: No writer source hit; enumerate context cookies and all metadata.
surfaces.requiredControl: Plant HTTP-only and script-visible cookie values/names.
surfaces.limit: No extension or other profile scope; unavailable collector is incomplete.

surfaces.surface: Origin Private File System
surfaces.expected: No writer source hit; enumerate files/directories and raw bytes when API available.
surfaces.requiredControl: Unknown nested path, binary encoding and chunk-boundary leak.
surfaces.limit: Access may create bookkeeping; unsupported API is incomplete, not an empty pass.

surfaces.surface: Account core SQLite: every current table/schema/TEXT/BLOB
surfaces.expected: Identity/attempts/public credentials/sealed recovery/proposals/receipts/encrypted submissions; W/F forbidden.
surfaces.requiredControl: Unknown table/column and TEXT/BLOB leak through read-only collector.
surfaces.limit: Current SQL snapshot includes visible WAL-backed rows; not physical WAL or freed pages.

surfaces.surface: Authority SQLite and sealed acceptance material in core
surfaces.expected: Public pin/salt/nonce/ciphertext and sealed private seed; known external factors prohibited.
surfaces.requiredControl: Unknown authority table/property and binary leak.
surfaces.limit: No attempt to infer all private key absence from W/F search; operator custody has separate tests.

surfaces.surface: Page errors/console and service stdout/stderr
surfaces.expected: No automatic W/F or operational token logging. Collect from before startup.
surfaces.requiredControl: Plant from actual app/service stream; scanner/runner output cannot satisfy the control.
surfaces.limit: Declare attached execution contexts; unexpected uncaptured worker is incomplete. Proxy/system/third-party logs deferred.

surfaces.surface: Private migration/cleanup diagnostics
surfaces.expected: No automatic content/factor output, including error paths.
surfaces.requiredControl: Synthetic failure containing W/F must be detected in utility stream.
surfaces.limit: Not executed in fresh R1; no personal private utility opened.

surfaces.surface: Intentional Markdown ZIP/recovery/binding downloads
surfaces.expected: Explicit plaintext artifact, exact inventoried file in separate disclosure trial.
surfaces.requiredControl: Unexpected cache/log copy remains prohibited even if extension is .zip.
surfaces.limit: R1 has no ZIP/compression decoder or export phase; no personal downloads inspected.

surfaces.surface: Legacy IndexedDB done and cleanup targets
surfaces.expected: Absent in fresh R1; known plaintext exists before synthetic migration cleanup.
surfaces.requiredControl: Legacy raw update is detectable; scan before and after cleanup with independent census.
surfaces.limit: Existing namespace absence tests do not establish physical erasure.

surfaces.surface: Old relay Yjs file and diagnostics
surfaces.expected: Old plaintext transport/source; separate from Account service.
surfaces.requiredControl: Synthetic old Yjs source contains W and must be detected in declared representation.
surfaces.limit: Do not start personal relay or inspect old personal ydoc.

surfaces.surface: Browser physical profile: backing files, HTTP cache, session/history and deleted data
surfaces.expected: Unknown until closed disposable profiles and readable formats are inventoried.
surfaces.requiredControl: Planted file/container and opener controls with explicit decoder coverage.
surfaces.limit: R1 API absence and C13 known opener attempts do not qualify filesystem residue. No personal profile inspection.

surfaces.surface: Service physical SQLite/WAL/SHM, freed pages and filesystem logs
surfaces.expected: Separate raw/container scan before checkpoint, VACUUM or cleanup.
surfaces.requiredControl: Planted old row/WAL/file bytes and unsupported container controls.
surfaces.limit: Current read-only SQL does not establish deleted-byte absence or OS secure erasure.

surfaces.surface: Existing copied-profile custody evidence
surfaces.expected: Known root candidates and synthetic future receiver; factor-present and planted opener controls.
surfaces.requiredControl: Retain existing promptless-opener positive control.
surfaces.limit: Not neutral plaintext scan, arbitrary opener enumeration or multi-platform qualification.

surfaces.surface: Existing known-namespace inventory and cleanup evidence
surfaces.expected: Equality and known legacy deletion only.
surfaces.requiredControl: New detector calibration required independently of these helpers.
surfaces.limit: A successful product parse, decryption or equality assertion is not byte-search coverage.
